note: Ps60 national lament after defeat (corrected; God-action + oracle heavy). Human IB core (thin, like a God-hymn): those who FEAR God (given a banner to flee to); God's BELOVED (yadid) people to be delivered; the disabused recognition that man's SALVATION (teshuah) is vain (shav); the God-confident 'with God we shall do VALIANTLY (chayil)'. God-qualifiers=20 (rejected x2/broke/angry/restore/quake/open/repair/made-drink judgment; delivered/give-salvation/answer; his holiness/exultation/divide/portion/triumph in the oracle; grant/help/tread-down). Land-ruin images + dominion-oracle place-claims (helmet/scepter/washbasin/shoe) + rhetorical questions + superscription = standalone. Every candidate roled.
